scores.reason: Memory management via micro-batching, not optimizer hyperparameter scaling rules.
Decentralized distributed training; multi-GPU communication optimization, not applicable to single-device scaling.
Proposes direction-aware momentum variant, but no batch size scaling rules or experiments on vision CNNs.

Empirical CIFAR-10 analysis of SGD showing lr-batch equivalence, but only covers SGD, not momentum or normalized/orthogonalized methods; no concrete scaling rules.

Batch size scaling laws for mini-batch SGD in linear regression (sketched), not vision CNNs; theoretical only, no concrete settings.
Weight consolidation for continual learning, unrelated to batch size scaling.

SNGM: normalized gradient descent + momentum for large-batch training, directly relevant to normalized/orthogonalized + momentum theme, but unclear if covers CIFAR-scale or provides concrete scaling rules (beta, warmup steps, BN group size).

Dimension-adapted Nesterov acceleration (DANA) with momentum scaling laws by model dimension and data complexity; theoretical rules provided, but experiments on synthetic quadratics only, not vision CNNs; not portable to CIFAR-100.

Normalized SGD + momentum showing momentum removes large-batch requirement; tested on ResNet-50 (CNN but full-scale, not CIFAR) and BERT; lacks critical batch size measurement vs. SGD/AdamW and concrete warmup/BN group settings for short horizons.
Local SGD vs. large-batch; distributed variants, not single-device batch scaling.
